title: czeslaw-c
description:
Static cinematic shot, identical framing and composition to the source image. Czesław stands at the bathroom mirror during shaving. He is preparing to deliver an intense, confrontational monologue to his own reflection, but this pass is only for later lip-sync.

His lips remain fully closed for the entire shot. No speaking, no mouth opening, no visible articulation, no smiling with parted lips.

Use only subtle facial acting: his eyes slowly harden, his brows tighten slightly, and his gaze locks onto his own reflection with growing suspicion and restrained challenge. A tiny shift of the jaw under closed lips, a faint narrowing of the eyes, minimal nostril tension, and very small changes in posture. He briefly pauses the shaving motion, studies himself, then slightly tilts his head as if silently asking a provocative question.

Keep the performance controlled, serious and psychologically tense, not exaggerated, not comedic in expression. The humor comes from Czesław treating the moment with complete sincerity.

The razor and shaving brush remain naturally in his hands. Very small hand movement only. No sudden gestures. No camera movement. No zoom. No morphing, no face distortion, no changing glasses, no extra fingers, no object deformation. Warm realistic bathroom lighting, natural mirror physics, hyperrealistic cinematic motion, 16:9.
